name: dragonmaw_illusion_female
_comment: Female Dragonmaw Illusion (creature 900962): standard orc female in a red fel skin. The orc female has no red tone of her own (her colour 10 is brown); skin, face and underwear are colour 27 of the Nexus Mods WoW mod 907 customisation pack (patch-A.MPQ, OrcFemale*00_27), shipped under Zep names. skin_color 0 only picks the green _Extra (mouth/tusks); the bake uses the sections.
